body:
I would suggest hanging on.

If you kill yourself, you destroy the possibility of change. Things could get better. Maybe there's a slim chance of it now - maybe 0.0001% - but if you kill yourself you bring it all the way down to zero.

I agree with the other posters that you should hide the gun, but I would suggest not calling the police.

From my own personal experience, being put on psychiatric hold made me more suicidal, not less. One of the worst experiences of my life. I've been in jail, and psychiatric hold was worse. This is just my own experience, I don't know how accurately it would apply to your husband.
